_about: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/check_privacy_manifests.py's source scan.
An entry hides one use of a required-reason API from one target's check:
"file": <repo-relative path>, "pattern": <regex over that line>, "reason": <why it needs no declaration>}
Use it only for a match that is not a call of the API (the scanner already skips comments, string
contents and code another platform's #if excludes). A call the binary makes is declared, not listed here.
An entry that no longer matches anything fails the check, so this list can only shrink.
